The '''CAV-11 "Condor"''' was an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and used by the [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] to intercept [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].
